'''Andrew Yborrando''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2001 EPP Overdrive tournament (Bridgewater Crew)]] on 18 July 2001 with EPP Vader deck, Mos Eisley start, according to Michael Pistone's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2669">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-19-madskills-epp-overdrive-ls-owns-youd2669/ madskills-epp-overdrive-ls-owns-you], DeckTech (Michael "MadSkills84" Pistone, 19 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-19-madskills-epp-overdrive-ls-owns-youd2669/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
